ns2:section.sectionText: Community Stewardship-Env Ed In this service learning course, students visit area schools (grades 4-8) to teach students about the impacts of introduced species using science-based information and facilitate student-developed community stewardship projects to help reduce the spread of aquatic invaders. Guest scientists and the Nab the Aquatic Invader! Web site (www.sgnis.org/kids) will serve as the foundation for the course. Students are responsible for their own transportation. Students must for this section and one of the lab sections CS1-7). NO PREREQUISITES REQUIRED. No field trip fee.
